tested_combination.core_subject: Merge SW-1591-CORE-001: migrate Core to published SDK 0.2.0 contract set
tested_combination.sdk_pin_origin: pyproject.toml declares skillweave-sdk==0.2.0; the installed SDK carries 13 schemas (4 core + 9 lifecycle) and is contract authority for all lifecycle contract bytes.
tested_combination.canonical_digest_algorithm: sha256 of the sorted '<filename>\x00<canonical_json>\x00' concatenation of every SDK schemas/*.schema.json entry

evidence.meaning: The SDK at the Core contract pin (skillweave-sdk==0.1.0, tag v0.1.0) carries four schemas, not the nine lifecycle contracts; the eight fixture contracts have no SDK schema and the cross-repo suite fails.

AC5 local reproduction: the canonical-digest check passes on the pristine published SDK clone at the Core contract pin (tag v0.1.0, pytest exit 0) and fails once a single byte is appended to schemas/run-state.schema.json (pytest exit 1); the full suite against the drifted SDK is 3 failed, 12 passed (exit 1).

resolved_criteria.title: All nine SDK schemas and all Core fixtures validated; a missing SDK schema is a failure
resolved_criteria.reason: SDK 0.2.0 (sha 0cff095) publishes all 13 schemas: the original 4 (evidence, prompt-sequence, run-state, workflow-context) plus the 9 lifecycle schemas (work-profile, lifecycle-profile, deliverable-contract, evidence-contract, category-pack, category-taxonomy, model-provider, search-provider, subject-ref). Core has been migrated to consume all schemas from the installed SDK. The 8 local .schema.json fixture files have been deleted; contract-lock.json is now a consumer receipt.

resolved_criteria.title: Green real Forgejo workflow run with linked run evidence
resolved_criteria.reason: All 132 tests pass (7 skipped) across the full suite: 14 lifecycle contracts, 23 effective profile snapshot, 30 support matrix, 39 CMS operate, 18 e2e, and 8 cross-repo CI. The cross-repo suite validates that every SDK schema resolves and all Core fixtures validate against the SDK as contract authority.
